topics.label: Lecture introduction and overview
topics.groupedBecause: This subtopic introduces the lecture by outlining how previously learned immune components are integrated in the initiation and resolution of inflammation.

topics.label: Innate immune recognition and pattern recognition receptors
topics.groupedBecause: These subtopics detail how the innate immune system identifies pathogens and cellular damage using conserved molecular patterns and diverse pattern recognition receptor pathways.

topics.label: The inflammatory cascade and leukocyte mobilization
topics.groupedBecause: These subtopics explore how sentinel cell activation initiates local and systemic inflammatory signals, coordinates leukocyte extravasation into tissues, and drives lymphatic transport.

topics.label: Resolution of inflammation, tissue repair, and chronic outcomes
topics.groupedBecause: These subtopics examine the passive and active mechanisms that terminate inflammation, drive tissue healing, and manage persistent insults through chronic inflammation and granulomas.

topics.label: Lecture conclusion
topics.groupedBecause: This subtopic concludes the session and previews the subject of the upcoming lecture.
